learning_outcomes.text: Explain the operation of essential components required to drive machines and systems.
Determine the component stresses resulting from static and dynamic loads and to dimension and design the components in accordance with the stresses and functions, with the use of CAD.
Solve constructive exercises and document and present the results in a structured elaboration.

syllabus_topics: Design tasks under consideration of the dimensioning and design rules for mechanical engineering components or assemblies
Solution concepts including description of the function
Technical drawings of the assembly with a list of parts
Chosen technical drawings of parts in CAD
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for participation in the module examination is passing the course achievement. The course achievement consists of a seminar paper on construction designs. The course achievement is granted if 3 out of 4 tasks have been passed. The module examination must be passed to receive credit points.
